headline: Poland Energy Ministry Proposes Gas Price Caps and Levies on Energy Firms for 2027
summary: Poland's Energy Ministry proposed maximum gas prices for households and protected consumers in 2027, alongside compensation for energy companies and levies on firms generating revenue from domestic gas sales.
why: Energy market regulatory interventions and price caps impact utility earnings and fiscal outlays in Poland's energy sector.

impacts.name: Poland
impacts.why: Price caps and sector levies directly affect energy company earnings and household utility costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
